objective: Re-review the root instruction change in commit 0cbedf0 that names where the workflow journal is and how an Assignment missing from the reports is closed.
scope: The diff at /tmp/holyagent-review/0cbedf0.diff, the parts in packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/workflows.md, packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements.md, packages/runtime/src/cli/overview.ts plan notes and docs/cache-and-workflows.md; read the full current files as needed.

Previous finding C: workflows.md said only 'the run's journal'. Expected fix: say the Workflow completion notice names it in its diagnostics as <transcript dir>/journal.jsonl, and state once that after the run completes an Assignment the reports do not list is closed errored without further confirmation.
Previous small item: unify the report placeholder as <report-file> in the root text and plan notes.

The worker noted it removed the clause 'since these agents cannot be messaged' from workflows.md to stay under the 31161-byte root prompt cap, relying on dispatch.md saying a workflow agent's gap is a new draft with followUpOf.
constraints: Apply the instruction-writing rules of the root prompt (packages/integrations/claude/dist/agents/holyagent.md, section Writing instructions) and the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.
Keep working until the review is done, then stop and report under 350 words; do not start further review rounds. Each evidence entry on one line as '<criterion label>: <support>'.

questions: none
notes:
- Placeholder: `<report-file>` is used in workflows.md, dispatch.md:5, dist/agents/holyagent.md:24 and overview.ts:195. The CLI help at assignment.ts:398 (and generated holyagent.js:12399) still says `< <path>`. Outside the named scope.
- The 31161-byte cap is not in the repo (no match for "31161"), so that claim is unverified.
- workflows.md dropped "a gap becomes a new draft with followUpOf". dispatch.md:7 still owns it, so nothing is lost.
- workflows.md:10 is one long paragraph. "by label" (workflows.md) and "named by its Assignment id" (overview.ts:194) name the same key.
- "transcript dir" is not defined in the root text. The reader takes its value from the notice.
evidence:
Finding C: closed. workflows.md:10 says the completion notice names the journal in its diagnostics as `<transcript dir>/journal.jsonl`, and says that after the run completes an unlisted Assignment is closed `errored` without further confirmation. The notice wording comes from the Workflow tool, outside this repo; plugin.test.ts:365-373 asserts the phrases but was not run.
Single statement: gap. docs/cache-and-workflows.md:50 repeats the closing rule in full instead of referring to workflows.md:10. requirements.md:328 (R-WORKFLOW) dropped the old closing clause ("closed errored once its agent is confirmed gone") without stating the new rule, so the requirement is silent on it. dist/agents/holyagent.md:105 says to change the behavior in requirements.md first. There is no direct contradiction: dispatch.md:7 (gap becomes a new draft with followUpOf) agrees with workflows.md:10, and overview.ts:195 refers to the root text correctly.
Clarity: met. workflows.md:10 gives the journal path, where the notice names it, the outcome `errored`, the timing ("once the run has completed") and the reason ("cannot be messaged") for closing without confirmation, so a reader with no context can act on it.
verdict: Finding C is closed and Clarity is met. Single statement is a gap, because the closing rule is copied into docs/cache-and-workflows.md:50 and requirements.md R-WORKFLOW no longer carries it.
